name.en-US: The Inner Way: Thirty-six Sermons for Festivals
name.pt-BR: O Caminho Interior: Trinta e Seis Sermões para as Festas

description.en-US: Thirty-six of Tauler's sermons for the festivals of the saints and of Our Lady, in A. W. Hutton's English of 1901 (after the early printed editions of 1498 to 1543, not Vetter's critical text), with Hutton's introduction. A different edition of the same work as Elliott's translation.
description.pt-BR: Trinta e seis sermões de Tauler para as festas dos santos e de Nossa Senhora, na tradução inglesa de A. W. Hutton (1901), com a introdução do tradutor.

sources.edition: The Inner Way, being thirty-six sermons for festivals by John Tauler, translated by A. W. Hutton (London: Methuen, 1901).
sources.description: OCR of the archive.org scan (research/sourcing/_scripts/hutton_build.py); sermons split at the SERMON headings, titles from the heading lines, running heads removed; page-foot notes remain as paragraphs. Not proofread.
